_note: 4-week block for an advanced ~182 lb lifter (upper-chest priority, protect L5/S1). Week 1 = baseline: set your working weights, no pre-fill. Wk2 accumulate (most sets ~1-2 reps in reserve), Wk3 intensify (small load jump, hold reps), Wk4 peak (top load, leave 1 in the tank) — then deload or retest and reset to Week 1. Numbers are coach targets, not gospel: your rep ranges govern. Matched by day title + exercise name; keep keys aligned with src/data/plan.ts.
